checkpoints.title: Known compiler crashes eliminated and status reproducible
criteria: The known corpus records no longer escape through FormationProjectionError.
The current status report can be regenerated from one deterministic package-local command.

checkpoints.title: Highest-impact current-scope gaps grounded and reduced
criteria: The largest current refusal classes have representative evidence and targeted corrections.
Previously unexercised implemented operations have compiler-level golden coverage.

checkpoints.title: Canonical duple vocabulary and documented parameter surfaces complete
criteria: Every canonical figure has an implemented, evidence-backed subset.
Every currently documented duple parameter deferral is implemented or remains refused for a recorded missing semantic input.

checkpoints.title: Additional formation families have independent semantics
criteria: Each enabled formation defines its own start, grouping, progression, boundary behavior, and oracle.
Formation-specific figures run only after their formation geometry is available.

decisions.decision: compendium_rubric consumes compendium_core taxonomy read-only; alignment work changes the consumer, not compendium_core.
decisions.effect: No unit may modify compendium_core to make a rubric operation easier to implement.

decisions.decision: Headline success uses only dances that parse without custom figures and contain no deliberately deferred figure or parameter.
decisions.effect: W2 preserves this denominator and all later corpus deltas report against it.

decisions.decision: Unsupported geometry remains an explicit refusal until a sourced or user-approved worked example determines the result.
decisions.effect: Figure units add the worked example before accepting new parameter surfaces; ambiguous inputs keep returning OpError.

decisions.decision: This plan covers the standalone compiler package and excludes integration with the rest of the application.
decisions.effect: Units may change package code, tests, docs, corpus harnesses, and package-local adapters, but not app UI, storage, or feature integration.

decisions.decision: Cell collisions and off-grid projections are compiler defects; valid dance refusals use OpError and never leak FormationProjectionError.
decisions.effect: W0 and W1 fix the known crashes without weakening projection invariants.

decisions.decision: Non-duple formations require their own start, grouping, progression, and oracle definitions.
decisions.effect: Phase 3 reuses duple behavior only when a test proves the behavior is formation-neutral.
